tvShow.name: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring
tvShow.originalName: 春夏秋冬代行者 春の舞
tvShow.overview: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

episodes.name: The Dance of Spring
episodes.overview: Ten years ago, the balance of the seasons was broken. Now two girls set out to return spring to a frozen land.

episodes.name: Lingering Snow
episodes.overview: The return of spring arouses painful memories and conflicting feelings in the Agent of Winter.

episodes.name: A Glimpse
episodes.overview: Hinagiku and Sakura go to stay with the Agent of Summer and stumble into a sisterly feud.

episodes.name: Morning Calm
episodes.overview: Insurgents attack the Agent of Summer's home. The two Guards fight back.

episodes.name: Alone Together
episodes.overview: Hinagiku and Sakura approach the Village of Spring, recalling painful memories.

episodes.name: A Place to Call Home
episodes.overview: Sakura reflects on her reunion with Hinagiku and the challenges they overcame to begin their journey.

episodes.name: Dusk
episodes.overview: The young Agent of Autumn and her Guard go about their lives in a high-tech fortress.

episodes.name: Spring Rain
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the latest attack, Rosei relives his past with Hinagiku and their violent separation.

episodes.name: United Front
episodes.overview: Rosei resolves to take action and contacts Sakura, only to get the last response he expected.

episodes.name: Afterimage
episodes.overview: Hinagiku recognizes Nadeshiko's kidnapper, and the newly united Agents finally identify their enemy.

episodes.name: Impatience
episodes.overview: Hinagiku and Sakura are waiting to meet the Winter duo at the Agency when the building comes under attack.

episodes.name: Assault
episodes.overview: Ishihara holds Rosei and Itecho at gunpoint, revealing her own past and the full scope of Kasai's attack.

episodes.name: Recapture
episodes.overview: Ruri, Ayame, and Rindo face Kasai in a battle to get Nadeshiko back.

episodes.name: Spring Flowers Bloom in Winter
episodes.overview: Hinagiku and Sakura confront Misuzu, and their pasts, head-on.
